notes.title: The Chameleon is an eerie stealth game featuring Hawaiian shirts and big punches
notes.notes: To make a great stealth game, atmosphere is crucial. Games are about interaction, so if your game involves spending long periods of time crouched behind a box, the world has to do a lot of work to make that experience interesting. It needs to find ways to make you feel like doing nothing is still an active choice, letting you plan your next moves through listening to the soundscape, or making you feel like staying in one place for too long is going to be a bad idea... Read more.

notes.title: ‘The Chameleon’ - Retro stealth game - Release date announced for PC!
notes.notes:
Transform into your enemies in this retro stealth game set in the 70s!

Mexican game developer Merlino Games (Antonio Freyre) has announced [b]JULY 13, 2021[/b] as the PC release date for The Chameleon, a stealth game with retro graphics in which you use super powers to make your way through a mysterious base.

[previewyoutube=G8iORfMEaiw;full][/previewyoutube]

[h2]Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Stealth Super Powers - Transform, dash, slow time down and super-punch enemies while you uncover the secrets of this mysterious facility.

[*] Unique Graphics - The Chameleon mixes graphics straight out of 1994 with modern effects like volumetric lights and particles. You can also switch between pixelated and hi-res graphics modes for extra accessibility.

[*] Original Soundtrack - 12 full-length, 70s-inspired tracks to immerse yourself in the world of The Chameleon.

[*] Concise, Tense Experience - 2-3 hours playtime, encouraging multiple playthroughs to find all the secrets and improve your score. Different achievements available for different playstyles (destroy all enemies, remain undetected, discover hidden areas, etc).
[/list]

About Merlino Games: https://www.merlinogames.com/about
Twitter: https://twitter.com/merlino_games
